description: Doggie Styling is a full-service grooming salon in Colorado Springs owned and operated by Veta Guerra, a groomer with over 20 years of experience. The salon offers bath and brush services, full grooming with haircuts, nail dremeling, tooth brushing, specialty treatments like blueberry facials and FURminator services, and accepts walk-in nail trims. Operating Tuesday through Saturday with same-day appointments available, the business honors military discounts and accepts Visa and Mastercard.
